decisions.heading: What Is the Average Australian Teacher Salary?

Midpoint of the eight states' graduate rates and of the eight top-of-scale rates, computed from teacherHubRows() (lib/data/teacher-pay/hub.ts), labelled as an unweighted midpoint, not an ABS average

The ABS benchmark: Education and training median weekly earnings from EE_MEDIAN_BY_INDUSTRY (lib/data/average-salary/index.ts), annualised with annualise() and dated by EE_RELEASE; note it covers all education employees, not classroom teachers only

Teacher yearly income after tax: take-home on the graduate midpoint and the top-of-scale midpoint via calculatePayBreakdown() (lib/constants/australian-tax.ts), linking to /tax-on/ for the exact amounts

decisions.heading: Retail Minimum Wage in Australia: Level 1 vs the National Minimum Wage
outline: Direct answer: the retail minimum wage is the Retail Award Level 1 adult rate from RETAIL_RATES (lib/constants/hospitality-award.ts), weekly and hourly, operative from RETAIL_AWARD.operativeFrom; place it beside NMW.weekly / NMW.hourly (lib/constants/minimum-wage.ts) in a two-row table

Junior retail minimum: percentages from RETAIL_JUNIOR_SCALE applied to Level 1, with the note that junior rates stop at Level 3 (RETAIL_JUNIOR_LEVEL_RESTRICTION) and a link to /junior-pay-rates/
State question in one sentence: the same Level 1 rate applies in NSW, QLD, VIC and every other state because the award is national (link /award-rates/); WA unincorporated employers are the exception
